Anularea copiei de rezervă va opri imediat copia de rezervă și va șterge toate fișierele legate de aceasta. Rularea în fundal va continua backupul în fundal și puteți verifica oricând progresul copiei de rezervă.

Vom trata aceste informații cu atenție și le vom folosi numai pentru a rezolva problema și le vom șterge imediat după aceea. Vă rugăm să ni-l trimiteți prin e-mail.

Welcome to Virtual Master. Please read the Privacy Statement and the Third-party notices carefully to learn how we ensure the safety of your personal information during the process of collection, usage, storage and sharing, and the relevant rights you own. We take industry-leading security technical measures to fully protect your personal information.

To browse and save local files, photos, and media, we will request for access to your device storage when you use such features.

To import apps from your device into the VM, we will request for apps list installed on your device, you should grant us the permissions, otherwise this feature will not be available.

The VM supports virtual hardware, such as cameras, microphones, GPS, sensors, vibrators, etc., which rely on the real hardware on your device. When you use some virtual hardware, we will ask for your consent before using the real hardware, and you can choose to refuse. Although this will cause the virtual hardware fail to work, it will not affect your continued use of Virtual Master.

We’ll collect your OAID and Android ID to do diagnostics when you encounter any technical difficulties and to do statistics of the overall usage of Virtual Master. We’ll ask for your authorization before collecting your OAID and Android ID.

For details about the third-party services used by the product, such as SDK, you can read the Third-party notices.

Please click “I Agree” to consent to our Privacy Statement and start to use this app.
